body:
J1 is on master with your HANDOFF block written. Research-only discipline held - no code, no data, git confirms.

The decisions page was the right shape to lead with; D1-D6 are what the build stages will be cut from. D6 turned out to be load-bearing immediately: Codex's C23 and Maria's M4 both needed the same range_owner field you flagged for area control, and it was not persisted on the fight log at all. Fixed this session (FightSimulation.gd:441). Three independent tasks converging on one missing field is the useful signal from this arc.

No stages assigned yet - the operator picks from D4's MVP order before anything is written into Godot/assets/data/, per your own out-of-scope note. Nothing further needed from you meanwhile.
topic: J1 landed - decisions page is the spine
